target.title: fix(telegram): deliver content instead of throwing when tag overhead fills chunk
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves Fixes #102910 — `splitTelegramHtmlChunks` throws when HTML tag overhead fills chunk, causing outbound delivery (outbound-adapter.ts) to fail. The fix strips rich formatting and retries as bounded plain text, so message content is delivered within the chunk limit. ## Why This Change Was Made In `appendText`, the `available <= 0 && !chunkHasPayload` branch previously threw. The fix clears `openTags`, sets a fallback flag, and resets — retrying as plain text. A guard in the main loop skips orphan close tags so no unopened fragments leak in. The existing `send.ts`/`rich-message.ts` try-catch fallback paths are preserved. ## User Impact **Before:** nested formatting + small limit = throw = outbound failure **After:** same input = bounded plain text, content delivered ## Evidence Branch: `fix/102910-telegram-tag-overhead` | Base: `upstream/main` | Node: v22.19.0 Linux x64 ### Outbound delivery path proof `splitTelegramHtmlChunks` is the chunker for `chunkTelegramOutboundText` (outbound-adapter.ts:56) and `buildChunkedTextPlan` (send.ts:954): ``` Input: x limit=10 Before fix: throws Error After fix: ["x"] Bounded (len<=10): PASS Content delivered: PASS No orphan close tags: PASS Normal path unchanged: PASS ``` ### Regression tests 68 passed, 1 test file ### Checks - oxfmt — passed - oxlint — passed - git diff --check — passed - autoreview --engine claude — **patch is correct (0.95)**, no findings ### Diff format.ts: +19 (flag + tag-strip + orphan-close skip) format.test.ts: +5 (verify bounded plain-text delivery) - [x] I understand what the code does - [x] Change is focused and does not mix unrelated concerns
